highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ports several hot color/interop paths to managed C# and bumps Skia to milestone 151.
highlights_body: Color conversion, premultiplication, and several HarfBuzzSharp/SKFourByteTag paths move from native calls to allocation-free managed code, and WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11. It also fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData and removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia engine to m151, including several upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs.
Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions, making it easier to use from safe contexts.

bullets.lead: Fixed native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks the native decoder resource on every call.

bullets.lead: Color and pixel math ported to managed C#
bullets.detail: SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, reducing P/Invoke overhead on hot color paths.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzzSharp and tag parsing made allocation-free
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now does a pooled UTF-8 encode instead of allocating, per-call char[4] allocations are removed from HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph results are read via zero-copy spans.
Optimizes SKColor hex parsing and adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads to avoid intermediate string allocations.

Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions early; also builds emsdk 5.0.6 libs with the new exnref exception handling and restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression.
Bumps the externals/skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The externals/skia WASM redefinition cleanup, HarfBuzzSharp allocation-free buffer encoding, and Emscripten 5.0.6 static library support

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line with the Skia m151 engine bump and the initial managed color/pixel math ports.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 continued the managed HarfBuzzSharp and tag-parsing performance ports and added the SKImage.FromEncodedData leak fix.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM support for .NET 11 and finalized the m151 engine bump ahead of stable.

harfbuzz_summary: Ports HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) to a pooled, allocation-free UTF-8 encode and removes a per-call char[4] allocation from Tag.Parse, plus SKShaper now reads glyph results via zero-copy spans.
